eps.t: Final Exams and a School Sleepover
eps.ov: Nene's life may be coming to an end, but school has her more worried than death.

eps.t: The Near Shore and the Far Shore
eps.ov: Nene and Akane race to rescue Aoi, only to land in hot water themselves.
Nene and friends find Aoi, but she doesn't seem quite her usual self.
Nene and Hanako find themselves in an unfamiliar place. A strange girl rescues them from masked villagers.
While Nene and Hanako get their bearings, Aoi and Akane grapple with more personal problems.
Hanako grants Nene's wish, and she's not happy about how. Now she faces a world without apparitions.
Nene and Kou retrace Mitsuba's footsteps, looking for a way back to the Boundary.
Nene and Kou may have found the clue they're looking for in a cursed house. But can they leave with it alive?
While Teru hunts for clues at a local shrine, Nene scrambles to escape an eerily familiar cave.
Kou believes they can make everything right by rescuing four-year-old Tsukasa from the Red House.

eps.t: One-way Train to the Far Shore
eps.ov: While Nene and friends prepare to enter the Boundary, their friends on the other side run into trouble.
Nene and Kou scramble to save Hanako from Teru's wrath while the Boundary collapses around them.
